arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: James Bopp argued no person should face harassment for political participation.
Bopp claimed the First Amendment protects private associations from compelled disclosure.
Robert McKenna argued the public must identify errors and fraud in government.
Chief Justice Roberts asked if the First Amendment analysis applies to all cases.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Washington law requires referendum signers to publish names. the sides that brought the case claim this chills speech. the opposing sides argue transparency serves the public interest.
